# Batch Movement Reconciliation

Pipeline companies typically match meter batches to scheduled batch movements when scheduling batches to be injected into a pipeline at a given point (the receipt point). Pipeline operations will also schedule those same batches to come off the pipeline at a different point (the delivery point). These schedules can then be imported into FLOWCAL.

As the meter batches are imported or manually entered, FLOWCAL can then match the meter batches to the scheduled batch movement based on delivery and receipt point, and the time and amount of the batch. FLOWCAL will model a single batch movement between delivery and receipt points by comparing the batches of meter members within two locations based on product, origin, destination, start time (both origin and destination), and the batch size (configured as GSV, NSV, or mass).

A single batch movement will be associated to at least two meters in two locations.

The purpose of having two different locations is to create an association to a batch movement between two different FLOWCAL meters that exist physically at the delivery and receipt points. This gives FLOWCAL enough information to narrow down a batch product and match on criteria as it travels from one location in the pipeline (the origin), to the delivery point in the pipeline (the destination).

The delivery and receipt points being at the location level within FLOWCAL allows for multiple meters to be located where batches are being injected into or coming off the pipeline.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 493;height: 176;" />

The meters located at the receipt and delivery points represent the start and end points (respectively) of the batch movement from the left to the right in the diagram. The area enclosed on the left is the Origin location to be configured and the area enclosed on the right is the Destination location to be configured.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example">

The origin of a batch movement is Location 1 and the destination of the movement is Location 2. A scheduled batch movement is imported with a start and end date at the origin of 12/01/2018 09:00:00 – 12/01/12:00:00 for a batch size of GSV = 2000. The scheduled batch movement also defines the start and end date for the destination to be 12/1/2018 13:00:00 – 12/1/2018 16:00:00.

Since the origin and destination of the batch movement correspond to Location 1 and Location 2, FLOWCAL will attempt to find batches within the meters on each of the locations that match the criteria defined on the batch movement schedule. The Batch Schedule Matching service will search through all meters within Location 1 to find a batch that matches the product, batch size, and origin start date from the schedule. Similarly, the Batch Schedule Matching service will search through all meters within Location 1 to find a batch that matches the product, batch size, and destination start date from the schedule.

</div>

</div>

Scheduled batch movements can be entered into FLOWCAL manually or imported from an Excel (.xls) file in the FLOWCAL-specified format. As batches are imported for meters with the [Reconcile Batches](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Liquids%20Tab.md#Reconcile) option enabled, FLOWCAL will try to match each batch to a scheduled batch movement via the Batch Schedule Matching service (FcSrvBatchScheduleMatching.exe). If a batch is unable to be matched, [exception 18205](../../Exceptions/Exception%20Directory/18000/18000-18999.md) will be generated and the queue entry will fail to be processed.

This method requires the **Liquids** add-on.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Manually Import">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Manually Import a Scheduled Batch Movement</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Manually Import">

<div class="procedure">

To import a scheduled batch movement manually:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Scheduled Batch Movement**.

2.  Click the **Browse** button to find a .xls file or type the file path into the edit box.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 497;height: 101;" />

3.  Click **Import**.

4.  When the import is complete, go to **Tools** \> **Batch Movement Reconciliation** to view the scheduled batch movements.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Automatically Import">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Automatically Import a Scheduled Batch Movement</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Automatically Import">

<div class="procedure">

To import a scheduled batch movement automatically, use the File Import service.

Specify the folder to check for scheduled batch movements in the [Service Configuration](../Services/Service%20Configuration.md) screen within the Liquid Imports tab. Any .xls files in the specified folder or its sub-directories will be imported.

If an imported meter batch cannot be matched to a scheduled batch movement, exceptions will be generated to alert the user.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Manually Enter SBM">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Manually Enter Scheduled Batch Movements</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Manually Enter SBM">

<div class="procedure">

To manually enter scheduled batch movements:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager** \> **Liquids** \> **Batch Movement Reconciliation**.
2.  Click **New**. The Scheduled Batch Movement Editor will open.
3.  Define the criteria for the scheduled batch movement desired and click **Save**.
4.  Click **Match** to manually associate batches to the schedule. (See: [Manually Associate Scheduled Batches](#Associate))



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 260;height: 355;" />

The product on the scheduled batch must match the product on the meter batch.

For additional information on field definitions, see <a href="#FileFormat" class="notelink">Scheduled Batch Movement File Format</a>.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Batch Schedule Matching Service">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Batch Schedule Matching Service</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Batch Schedule Matching Service">

Queue entries on the Batch Matching tab of the Service Queues will be processed by the FcSrvBatchScheduleMatching.exe service. FLOWCAL will then attempt to associate meter batches to the scheduled batch movements defined in the Batch Movement Reconciliation Viewer.

If the service is unable to associate a batch to both the origin and destination specified on the scheduled batch movement, the queue entry status will be set to "Failed". If the service associates a batch to the origin and destination specified on the scheduled batch movement, the queue entry will be cleared from the list and the meter batches will now be associated to the scheduled batch movement.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 604;height: 268;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Location Setup for SBMs">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Location Setup for Scheduled Batch Movements</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Location Setup for SBMs">

To set up location information for scheduled batch movements, the following must be configured in the Location Editor (**Setup** \> **Location** \> **Editor** \> **Tools** \> **Info**):

- The meter containing the batch, matching the origin within the schedule, must belong to the location that has the origin defined in Custom Field 1.
- The meter containing the batch, matching the destination within the schedule, must belong to the location that has the destination defined in Custom Field 1.
- Set the tolerance for the batch’s volume or mass and start time on the location, so that they fall within the range for the scheduled batch movement.
  - The total volume or mass for the actual meter batch must match the scheduled batch movement amount within the tolerance setup on the location. The tolerance is defined using the **Volume or Mass Must Be Within** value.
  - The start date and time of the actual meter batch must match the start time of the scheduled batch movement within the tolerance setup for the location. The tolerance is defined using the **Start Time Must Be Within** value.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 520;height: 280;" />

</div>

<span id="Associate"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Manually Associate">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Manually Associate Scheduled Batches</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Manually Associate">

If a meter batch fails to be associated with a scheduled batch movement and does not fall within the scheduled batch movement tolerances defined in the [Location Editor](../../Locations/Location%20Editor/Location%20Editor.md), you can manually associate a meter batch to the scheduled batch movement.

<div class="procedure">

To manually associate a meter batch:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager** \> **Liquids** \> **Batch Movement Reconciliation**.
2.  Specify the location, where the match should occur, and date range criteria that fits the schedule you want to modify.
3.  Double-click the schedule to bring up the Batch Movement Association Editor.
4.  Select **Batches Filtered**.
5.  Change the filter criteria for origin date, destination date, and batch size to meet the criteria for the meter batch.
6.  When meter batch appears, click **Edit**.
7.  Right-click the batch and select **Associate**, then **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 504;height: 402;" />

</div>

</div>

<span id="FileFormat"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="SBM File Format">
